Question: Which regions have no low criticality locations?

rank_trace.sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.region FROM locations l WHERE l.region NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l2.region FROM locations l2 WHERE l2.criticality = 'low' );

SELECT l.region FROM locations l GROUP BY l.region HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN l.criticality = 'low' THEN 1 END) = 0;
